summary: Limited time savings on a best selling range! Promotion starts 1st of June 2024 until 31st July 2024 or while stocks last.
title: Eofy Special! 30% Off Meteor Stainless Steel Basins
bodyHtml:
Limited Time Savings on a Best Selling Range

Meteor Basins are celebrated for their timeless shape, sleek lines, and impeccable seamless construction, adding a touch of sophistication to any bathroom. They are available in stunning brushed stainless steel finishes, featuring trending options such as brushed brass, brushed gun metal, and brushed copper.

Special EOFY Pricing

For a limited time only, from 1st of June to 31st of July, 2024, we're slashing prices from $1,099 to just $769! Plus, each basin comes with a matching plug & waste, adding a further saving of $89.

Superior Functionality

Our Meteor Basins feature an insulation pad that helps maintain water temperature and dampens the sound of water falling into the vessel, providing a more serene bathroom experience.

Crafted from 304-grade stainless steel from a single piece, Meteor Basins boast a seamless forged design, ensuring durability and eliminating the risk of leaks.

Easy Maintenance

Keeping your Meteor Basin pristine is a breeze—simply clean with soapy water and a wet cloth and you're good as gold!
